name: Frontend Developer
description: Designs, builds, and maintains responsive, accessible, and user-centric web application interfaces.

skills.name: HTML
skills.importance: Essential for creating semantic, accessible, and well-structured web documents.

skills.name: CSS
skills.importance: Required for responsive layouts using Flexbox, CSS Grid, media queries, and modern styling.

skills.name: JavaScript
skills.importance: Core programming language for DOM manipulation, client-side interactivity, and asynchronous requests.

skills.name: React
skills.importance: Standard frontend library for component-based architecture, state management, and reusable UI development.

skills.name: Responsive Web Design
skills.importance: Ensures web applications provide an optimal layout and experience across all device screens.

skills.name: Version Control (Git)
skills.importance: Crucial for code tracking, branching workflows, team reviews, and collaborative development.

skills.name: REST APIs & HTTP
skills.importance: Necessary for client-server communication, JSON data handling, and fetching backend resources.

skills.name: Web Accessibility (a11y)
skills.importance: Ensures websites conform to WCAG guidelines and remain usable for people with disabilities.

skills.name: Problem Solving
skills.importance: Key for identifying UI defects, debugging runtime script errors, and edge-case resolution.

skills.name: Communication
skills.importance: Essential for coordinating effectively with designers, product owners, and backend developers.

skills.name: Attention to Detail
skills.importance: Critical for translating design mockups and design systems into pixel-consistent user interfaces.

skills.name: Adaptability & Continuous Learning
skills.importance: Vital for staying current with fast-evolving web standards, frontend tools, and framework ecosystems.

name: Data Analyst
description: Inspects, cleans, transforms, and analyzes datasets to uncover actionable insights and support strategic decision-making.

skills.name: SQL
skills.importance: Fundamental for querying relational databases, filtering, joining tables, and performing aggregations.

skills.name: Spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets)
skills.importance: Foundational tool for rapid data exploration, pivot tables, lookup functions, and ad-hoc calculations.

skills.name: Python
skills.importance: Core programming language for automated data cleaning, processing pipelines, and data analysis.

skills.name: Data Manipulation (Pandas & NumPy)
skills.importance: Industry standard libraries for tabular data operations, missing value handling, and transformations.

skills.name: BI & Data Visualization Tools (Tableau / Power BI)
skills.importance: Crucial for building interactive stakeholder dashboards and monitoring key organizational metrics.

skills.name: Data Visualization Libraries (Matplotlib / Seaborn)
skills.importance: Enables programmatic generation of charts for exploratory data analysis and insight validation.

skills.name: Applied Statistics
skills.importance: Required for summarizing distributions, calculating variance, and avoiding misleading interpretations.

skills.name: Data Cleaning & Quality Assurance
skills.importance: Ensures analytical reliability by identifying anomalies, duplicates, and invalid records.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.importance: Crucial for evaluating data objectivity, identifying underlying patterns, and questioning assumptions.

skills.name: Data Storytelling & Presentation
skills.importance: Enables translating complex numerical findings into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders.

skills.name: Business Acumen
skills.importance: Helps map analytical investigations to business goals, performance indicators, and user needs.

skills.name: Collaboration
skills.importance: Essential for collaborating with department leaders, software teams, and data engineering.

name: Cloud Engineer
description: Provisions, configures, automates, and maintains cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines for reliable service delivery.

skills.name: Cloud Core Services (AWS / Azure / GCP)
skills.importance: Foundational understanding of core compute, storage, virtual networks, and identity/access management.

skills.name: Linux & Command Line
skills.importance: Primary operating system environment for server administration, package management, and system tasks.

skills.name: Networking Fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPC)
skills.importance: Essential for configuring subnets, routing tables, security groups, and troubleshooting network connectivity.

skills.name: Containerization (Docker)
skills.importance: Enables packaging software into standardized portable containers for reproducible execution across environments.

skills.name: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
skills.importance: Enables declarative provisioning, versioning, and safe reproducibility of cloud infrastructure.

skills.name: CI/CD Pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions / GitLab CI)
skills.importance: Automates software build, testing, and continuous deployment workflows to cloud targets.

skills.name: Cloud Security Basics
skills.importance: Mandatory for applying least-privilege access, managing secrets, and securing cloud boundaries.

skills.name: Monitoring & Logging (e.g. CloudWatch / Prometheus)
skills.importance: Allows tracking cloud infrastructure health, configuring alerts, and reviewing application logs.

skills.name: Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
skills.importance: Crucial for methodically diagnosing infrastructure incidents, deployment failures, and network timeouts.

skills.name: Technical Documentation
skills.importance: Vital for maintaining architecture diagrams, disaster recovery runbooks, and onboarding guides.

skills.name: Collaboration & Teamwork
skills.importance: Necessary for pairing with developers, operations, and security teams during project rollouts.

skills.name: Adaptability
skills.importance: Cloud ecosystems and managed services update rapidly, requiring continual adaptation to new tools.

name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Develops, trains, evaluates, and integrates machine learning models and data pipelines into production applications.

skills.name: Python
skills.importance: Primary language for model development, scientific computing, data manipulation, and pipeline orchestration.

skills.name: Applied Mathematics & Linear Algebra
skills.importance: Core theoretical basis for matrix calculations, gradient descent optimization, and vector spaces.

skills.name: Probability & Statistics
skills.importance: Underpins hypothesis testing, distribution evaluation, statistical inference, and metric significance.

skills.name: Classical Machine Learning (Scikit-Learn)
skills.importance: Foundational for supervised and unsupervised algorithms, regression, classification, and clustering.

skills.name: Data Processing & Feature Engineering
skills.importance: Essential for transforming raw data into reliable features through normalization, encoding, and scaling.

skills.name: Model Evaluation & Validation
skills.importance: Ensures model generalization across datasets using cross-validation, precision, recall, and ROC-AUC.

skills.name: Deep Learning Fundamentals (PyTorch / TensorFlow)
skills.importance: Covers core concepts of multi-layer neural networks, loss backpropagation, and tensor operations.

skills.name: Version Control (Git)
skills.importance: Necessary for tracking code experiments, sharing pipelines, and collaborative software development.

skills.name: Model Serving & APIs (FastAPI / Flask)
skills.importance: Required for exposing trained model inference endpoints to client applications and services.

skills.name: Analytical & Experimental Thinking
skills.importance: Critical for systematically formulating hypotheses, interpreting validation loss, and iterating models.

skills.name: Cross-Functional Communication
skills.importance: Essential for explaining model trade-offs, confidence levels, and technical behavior to non-ML team members.

skills.name: Research & Continuous Learning
skills.importance: Necessary to keep pace with rapid research advancements, modern frameworks, and open-source models.

skills.name: Ethical AI & Data Privacy
skills.importance: Promotes awareness of algorithmic bias, training data representativeness, user privacy, and compliance.
